title: Decompose lint into domain-aware shards and add dependency quarantine gate
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Split lint into targeted shards to reduce CI latency for small changes; introduced a dependency quarantine policy to reduce noisy dependabot churn and mitigate high-risk transitive updates.
description:
Summary: This PR decomposes the monolithic lint job into lightweight, domain-aware shards and introduces a 'dependency quarantine' gating mechanism for automated dependency updates. The change reduces CI latency on small PRs, improves cache locality for lint artifacts, and gives security/infra teams a short quarantine window to triage risky dependency bumps before they automatically land.

Context and motivation: Our monolithic lint step took ~4-6 minutes for trivial changelists and was a large contributor to noisy CI queues. Dependabot/auto-upgrades have caused several surprising regressions due to transitive changes that slip through quick green builds. This work implements two complementary mitigations:

1) Lint shards: split lint into package-grouped shards (sdk-ts, sdk-py, runtime, infra, docs) and a fast-change detector that runs only the shards relevant to the touched paths. Shards run in parallel and use per-shard cache keys to avoid cross-shard invalidation.

2) Dependency quarantine: new policy that classifies dependabot PRs by risk score (major vs minor vs patch + transitive-impact heuristic). Low-risk patches still auto-merge after standard CI. Medium/high-risk updates are placed into a quarantine lane: they run an extended pipeline (full unit + integration smoke + lint shards) and require explicit approval from an oncall or security reviewer before merging.

Changes included:
- GH Actions: added .github/workflows/lint-shard-matrix.yml and updated existing test workflows to include shard-aware triggers.
- New script bin/ci/changed-paths-detect (bash/ts shim) to compute minimal affected shard set.
- CI caching: per-shard cache keys and separate action cache scopes for node_modules and python venvs.
- Dependabot: update auto-merge rules and add actions/dependency-quarantine.yml that labels/pins quarantined PRs.
- Documentation: docs/ci/sharding.md and docs/ci/dependency-quarantine.md with operator runbooks and rollback steps.

Commits (high level):
- 8c1d9b7: initial lint shard matrix + fast-path detection
- d2f7a04: cache key refactor and shard-specific cache scopes
- f4b1eae: dependency quarantine workflow + risk classifier
- a5d7c13: docs and runbook + unit tests for detector
- b9e3f2c: followups (fix flake in infra shard)

Files changed (high level):
- .github/workflows/* (added lint-shard-matrix.yml, dependency-quarantine.yml, updated test-workflow.yml)
- bin/ci/changed-paths-detect (new)
- scripts/ci/cache-helpers.sh (updated)
- docs/ci/*.md (new)
- packages/sdk-ts/.github/* (shard labels)
- packages/sdk-py/.github/* (shard labels)

Impact and performance numbers observed on staging:
- Median lint latency for small PRs (1-3 files): reduced from 4m32s -> 52s (fast-path)
- CI queue time for lint runners: down 35% during peak runs
- Quarantine lane prevented 3 auto-merged dependabot PRs from merging into main during initial 2-week trial, giving security team time to flag a transitive semver-major in a nested package

Safety/rollback:
- Shards are opt-in per package via shard-mapping files; fallback exists to run the full lint job (legacy-lint) if shard detector fails.
- Dependency quarantine labels and rules are reversible; an emergency toggle (org secret ENABLE_DEP_QUARANTINE=false) bypasses quarantine and reverts to previous auto-merge behavior.
- Added observability: metrics (ci.lint.shard.duration, ci.deps.quarantine.count) and two dashboards (Console -> CI Health).

Notes on developer experience:
- Local dev: running 'scripts/ci/run-lint.sh --shard infra' will reproduce shard runs locally.
- We added a 'fastpath' badge on PRs to indicate when only fast shards ran.

- Diego Rivera (approver): "Smoke-tested locally and on canary; lgtm after CI passes."

Operators: After merge, ops should monitor ci.lint.shard.duration and ci.deps.quarantine.count for unexpected regressions. If major regressions occur, toggle ENABLE_DEP_QUARANTINE to false and revert shard matrix by reverting this PR.
